$comment: The source of sf-spinner's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/spinner (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

size.summary: The size ladder: at each step the spinner is the icon of an sf-button of the same size (diameter and stroke), so it can stand in for that icon.

label.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Loading…" in English).

delay.summary: Milliseconds before the spinner shows (owner decision C130 (8); the name is final by C138): a wait shorter than that shows nothing. 0 shows at once. Written as data-delay; without the attribute the sheet's 1 s holds.

label-hidden.summary: The label is said and not shown (SP-07; the name is final by C138): it stays the spinner's name for a screen reader (and what announce says) while the page shows the ring alone. label="" takes the words from both.

kind.summary: One look, the arc (owner decision C130 (5)). breathing, comet and dots are former values until 2027-01-01 and draw the arc; so does a page's data-sf-spinner.

refresh-spinner.x-summary: Draws the spinner again from its settings (after the page changed data-sf-spinner around it)
refresh-spinner.summary: Re-renders the bound spinner root from its current configuration; does nothing before it is bound.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: role status (a polite, atomic live region) only while announce is on and the label is not empty; otherwise the drawing is aria-hidden and has no role. It takes no focus. label-hidden keeps the label as the name and hides it visually; only label="" leaves the spinner without a name.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-spinner for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

x-summary: Indeterminate waiting indicator, one look (the arc) on the size ladder, shown after a delay (1 s by default), in the place's quiet ink, with optional polite status announcement and Framework-owned motion.
x-renamed: settings.dots: type string with the numeral default "8" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.filled: type string with the numeral default "3" → number (§16 item 29)
lang runtime also holds the words of SPINNER_TEXT (ui-source/src/component/spinner/js/_spinner.js): a shared script this component draws with (§11: no word lives only inside a bundle)
settings.variant: the kind axis's old name, a dated setting alias of kind
settings.width, height, stroke-width, dot-radius: the pixel geometry deprecated since 1.1.0 (journal attribute-spinner-pixel-geometry) leaves the interface; still drawn and noted until 2026-12-01
methods.getSpinnerRoot: a reader retires (§4.4), kept and noted until the date
x-decisions: version: 1.1.0 → 1.2.0: variant is a dated alias, the pixel geometry and getSpinnerRoot retire behind dated rows, dots and filled are numbers; a minor while the rows hold (§4.10).

a11y-role: one role, status, written with when {announce: true}: the root is a polite atomic live region only while announce is on and the label is not empty; otherwise it is aria-hidden and has no role. The name is the label (an empty label is a spinner with no words, as the table's).

existing-aliases: compatibility.deprecations (width, height, stroke-width, dot-radius → size) fold into aliases.json as retired attribute rows with the dates; the shared class spinner still reads and notes them until the sweep, and the element observes them.
number-type: dots and filled are integers (§16 item 29); the shared drawing clamps them.
refresh-spinner: kept, the element's own redraw (it is not the vocabulary's refresh, which re-reads data); it answers applied.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json plus the looks, an announced spinner and one with no words; probe.json drives the role, the name and the aliases.
skeleton: none; the spinner is itself what stands in while something loads, with no port and no late data (§5.4).
css-variables: six public variables read by the class sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.2.1: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.4: the ring is drawn inside the icon's live area, not across its box (docs review R027, owner decision C11, 2026-11-07): on the 24-unit grid its outer edge is 20 units (radius 9 at stroke 2), as Material Symbols draw in 20 of their 24 units; the box stays the icon box of the step (simai/ui-source#10), the track, the arc, the comet and the dots share the ring, and the proportion is the same at every step (component.spinner 1.1.0). The docs say so.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-11, DEV J1/S1, component.spinner 1.2.0): the ring under the arc is the spinner's ink at 16 % (the fill family of the alpha scale), drawn whole. The alpha is in --sf-spinner-track-color, whose default is color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); the ring has no opacity of its own (it was --sf-surface-container under an opacity of 30 %, about 5 % of grey, and could not be seen). The words take the ink of the place (--sf-spinner-text-color defaults to currentColor, was --sf-on-surface): on a fill they are its on-colour. sf-button and sf-button-icon draw exactly as before (their ring was already this; they now set only the colour). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-13, SP-07 of control/research/2026-11-13-skeleton-spinner.md, component.spinner 1.3.0): label-hidden (boolean; the name is final by owner decision C138, 2026-11-14) keeps the label as the spinner's name for a screen reader and hides the words visually; the only way to hide them was label="", which also took the name. The words stay in the drawing (.sf-loader--text, visually hidden by .sf-loader--label-hidden), so a spinner that does not announce is read in place and one that announces says them. Without label-hidden nothing changes.

version 1.4.0, the looks (2026-11-13, owner decision C130 (5), (6), (8)): one look, the arc. kind takes '' and arc; breathing, comet and dots are dated value aliases of arc until 2027-01-01 (journal value-spinner-one-look), and a page's data-sf-spinner draws the arc too (the class spinner notes it). A spinner on its own is on-surface-variant, its words small text (--sf-text-size-1/2) at every size; a control's own spinner keeps the control's ink. The show delay: the setting delay (milliseconds, default 1000; the name is final by owner decision C138, 2026-11-14) hides the spinner for that long after it is drawn, by an animation of visibility, so a wait under a second shows nothing; written as data-delay only when the attribute is given, the sheet's 1 s otherwise. component.spinner 1.3.0.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-15, group build 6; numbered above 1.4.0 on refs/remotes/origin/fix/accordion-c154): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently by this unit: only its on-screen words ship in the bundle, the rest of lang/*.json stays for the Studio and the docs (LC-2, fix/localization-lc).

version 1.4.2 (2026-11-16, owner decision C220, closes C130 (7)): a patch here, the drawing comes from component.spinner 1.4.0: under prefers-reduced-motion nothing turns and no arc is drawn, the whole ring is the spinner's ink at 32 % (the paused bar and ring of C131 (8)), on its own, in a button and in a field alike. The docs say so; the words' ink note (RG-SP-1) is corrected in the class sheet. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.5.1 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.5.0 on origin/fix/smart-pass-sp1): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

version 1.5.2 (written on the branch as 1.5.0; 2026-11-17, owner decision C130 (5); Smart joint pass SM-SP-3; numbered above 1.4.2 of group build 9): a minor. dots, filled and direction leave the settings: they set the dots look, which is gone (one look, the arc), and drew nothing while the passport and the reference listed them as working. They are retired attributes with breathing, comet and dots' date: an sf-spinner that writes one draws the arc as before and is noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01 (journal attribute-spinner-dots-settings-retired). The element no longer writes data-dots, data-filled and data-direction into its drawing. The p4 probe that read them as numbers is gone. Size, label, delay, label-hidden, kind, infinite and announce unchanged.

version 1.5.3 (2026-11-18, group build 13; above every origin branch): a patch, words only. The C278 language packs (feat/lang-packs-c278 in fix/lang-follow, and the group build's words for the merged branches) gave this component its language files in de, es, fr, it, pt-br, ja, ko, zh-hans and ar; the pair before carried them under the same number. No behaviour, setting, key or Russian and English word changes.

version 1.5.4 (2026-11-19, group build 14; above every origin branch): a patch, probe only. fix/manifest-probes-round (ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-19-manifest-probes-round) made the manifest probe (examples.json and the probe.json generated from it) follow the decided behaviour (p5-aliases); the pair before carried the old checks under the same number. No code, setting, word or drawing changes.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: setting or clearing aria-busy on the containing region
inventing completion, error or timeout messages

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-spinner for a bounded waiting state whose progress cannot be expressed as a meaningful percentage.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use Spinner when determinate Progress or content-matched Skeleton is more accurate
Do not omit the containing region's aria-busy state
Do not announce an empty or non-localized label
Do not choose a spinner look: there is one, the arc; breathing, comet, dots and data-sf-spinner are former names until 2027-01-01
Do not set delay="0" to make a short wait visible: a wait under a second shows nothing on purpose

accessibility.focus: Spinner is not interactive and never enters the focus order.

getSpinnerRoot.summary: Returns the inner spinner root (.sf-loader-container), or null before render.
